question: Can a bounded public-action-consequence hypothesis tournament grow local structural exceptions, preserve the old mechanism across reversible law changes, and outperform fully specified equal-observation controls?
hypothesis: Local exception promotion with a hysteresis window of eight outcome witnesses should beat unmodified raw/base prediction on changed-rule phases, maintain cold checkpoint functional identity and recover old-rule readout when old rules return. A fully informed same-window symbolic filter is expected to tie it, and strong smoothed window counts may outperform it. No novel source or general scientific advantage is claimed.

synthetic_source.license: Original generated fixture code, no original CausalGym or source datasets
synthetic_source.public_features: One forced and shared action a and two public binary context observations x,z; observed binary consequence y. No world or phase label passed into any learner.
synthetic_source.worlds: Baseline mechanism y=a XOR x with Bernoulli 0.9 agreement. Phase B inverts its consequence only at a,x,z=1,1,1; phase C inverts only at 1,0,1. No hidden-context control available to learner.
synthetic_source.observation_generator: Deterministic SHA256('csrr01:'+seed+':'+t+':'+cell) first uint32 / 2^32 compared with source p. Evaluator alone computes exact Bernoulli expected Brier before each update; no evaluator risk/phase identity to model.
synthetic_source.limitations: Baseline XOR law, rule family and capacity preprogrammed. Per-cell exception growth is a bounded structural lookup; no independent unknown-family discovery is established.

frozen_design.split: Prospective six consecutive 256-step phases A,B,A,C,A,B. No independent held real data. Cold state serialization at global step 511, then continued side-by-side for identity.
frozen_design.ordering: Global time t 0..1535 inclusive for each seed, public cell=(5*t+seed)%8. All policies receive exactly the same (a,x,z,y) and the same 4608 observations total.
frozen_design.data_budget: 4608 source-free synthetic observations (3 seeds * 6 phases * 256), all shared across all comparators; no original source actions
frozen_design.compute_budget: Node.js v22 standard library only; deterministic bounded 8 cells, 8 observation history per active cell, no external models or paid API
frozen_design.capacity: Regenerator: XOR baseline, 8 public-context exception candidates, 8-witness rolling binary contradiction history per cell, at least 6 witnesses, promote on >=5 mismatches, revert on <=1, otherwise preserve mode; immutable SHA256 guarded snapshot with cold clone. Controls: raw XOR, global smoothed per-cell counts, 8-witness smoothed per-cell counts, and symbolic fully informed exception-locus (cells 5/7) selector with same hysteresis.
frozen_design.evaluator: Prequential exact expected Bernoulli Brier on one shared sampled public input per step, with secondary harness-only uniform-grid expected Brier over all 8 cells. Neither evaluator probability nor phase label is passed into update or predict.

controls: Strong informed symbolic exception-locus hypothesis tournament, same observations and local evidence window
metrics: Cold checkpoint exact future prediction identity
Total matched observations and execution resource provenance

classification_rules.supported: ENGINEERING_ADVANTAGE_DEV_ONLY only if both novel cell exceptions 5/7 detected, changed-regime mean Brier improves >=0.005 over raw, mean old return drift <= +0.02, cold mismatch count zero, whole-run Brier improves >=0.005 over BOTH smoothed window and informed symbolic control. This is NOT scientific-supported.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV_ONLY if both exception loci detected, changed-regime raw gain >=0.005, old return drift <= +0.02, cold mismatch count zero, but no >=0.005 margin over BOTH strong controls. No intelligence claim.
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV_ONLY if detected exceptions missing, changed-regime raw gain <0.005, or old return drift > +0.02; no post-run changes.
classification_rules.invalid: Any difference in action/outcome information across comparators, any hidden phase/world/evaluator leakage into model, bad public input/cold-checkpoint negative control, cold prediction mismatch, mismatch in 4608 observation budget, source-first-use, or changed settings after prereg.
